onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault() if (!title.trim() || busy) return const from = scope === 'day' ? day ? new Date(`${day}T${time || '00:00'}`).toISOString() : null : starts ? new Date(starts).toISOString() : null const to = scope === 'day' ? day ? new Date(`${endDay || day}T${endTime || time || '00:00'}`).toISOString() : null : ends ? new Date(ends).toISOString() : null if (from && to && Date.parse(to) < Date.parse(from)) { setLocalError('截止时间不能早于开始时间。') return } if (reminder && !from && !to) { setLocalError('请先设置任务时间，再添加提醒。') return } setLocalError('') const pendingTag = tagText.trim().slice(0, 32) onSubmit({ title: title.trim(), scope, parent_id: validParent || null, starts_at: from, due_at: to, description: description.trim(), category: category.trim(), priority, tags: [...new Set([...tags, ...(pendingTag ? [pendingTag] : [])])].slice(0, 10), reminder_minutes: reminder === '' ? null : Number(reminder), status, completed: status === 'completed', completed_at: status === 'completed' && completedAt ? new Date(completedAt).toISOString() : null, ...(task?.demo_revision ? { demo_revision: task.demo_revision } : {}), }) }}

onChange={() => { setScope(value) setParent('') if (!task && value !== 'day') { const from = value === 'week' ? startOfWeek(initialDate) : initialDate setStarts(`${dateKey(from)}T09:00`) setEnds(`${dateKey(addDays(from, value === 'week' ? 6 : 30))}T18:00`) } }}
<button type="button" aria-label="清除任务日期" onClick={() => setDay('')}>
<button type="button" aria-label="清除开始时间" onClick={() => setTime('')}>
<button type="button" aria-label={`移除标签 ${tag}`} onClick={() => setTags(tags.filter((value) => value !== tag))} >
onChange={(theme) => change({ theme: theme as Preferences['theme'] })}
onChange={(fontSize) => change({ fontSize: fontSize as Preferences['fontSize'] })}
onChange={(fontFamily) => change({ fontFamily: fontFamily as Preferences['fontFamily'] }) }
onChange={(density) => change({ density: density as Preferences['density'] })}

<button role="switch" disabled={saving} aria-label="减少动态效果" aria-checked={preferences.reducedMotion} className={`automation-switch ${preferences.reducedMotion ? 'enabled' : ''}`} onClick={() => change({ reducedMotion: !preferences.reducedMotion })} >

<button className="secondary-button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => change({ theme: defaultPreferences.theme, fontSize: defaultPreferences.fontSize, fontFamily: defaultPreferences.fontFamily, density: defaultPreferences.density, reducedMotion: defaultPreferences.reducedMotion, }) } >

onClick={() => change({ theme: defaultPreferences.theme, fontSize: defaultPreferences.fontSize, fontFamily: defaultPreferences.fontFamily, density: defaultPreferences.density, reducedMotion: defaultPreferences.reducedMotion, }) }
<button disabled={busy} aria-pressed={settings.mode === 'blank'} onClick={() => choose({ mode: 'blank', selected: null })} >
<button disabled={busy} aria-pressed={settings.mode === 'builtin'} onClick={() => choose({ mode: 'builtin', selected: null })} >
<button disabled={busy} aria-pressed={settings.mode === 'custom' && settings.selected === image.id} onClick={() => choose({ mode: 'custom', selected: image.id })} >

<button className="icon-button" disabled={busy} aria-label={`删除背景 ${image.name}`} onClick={() => void perform(() => saveBackground( settings.selected === image.id ? { mode: 'blank', selected: null } : settings, undefined, image.id ) ) } >
onClick={() => void perform(() => saveBackground( settings.selected === image.id ? { mode: 'blank', selected: null } : settings, undefined, image.id ) ) }
onChange={(event) => { const file = event.target.files?.[0] event.target.value = '' if (file) void perform(() => importBackground(file)) }}

onSubmit={async (event) => { event.preventDefault() setSaving(true) setSaved(false) setError('') try { await savePreferences( { displayName: displayName.trim(), email: email.trim(), bio: bio.trim(), avatar, }, baselineRevision ) setDirty(false) setSaved(true) setError('') } catch (failure) { setError((failure as Error).message) setSaved(false) } finally { setSaving(false) } }}

onChange={async (event) => { const file = event.target.files?.[0] event.target.value = '' if (!file) return setReading(true) setError('') setSaved(false) try { setAvatar(await readAvatar(file)) } catch (failure) { setError((failure as Error).message) } finally { setReading(false) } }}
<button type="button" className="secondary-button" disabled={!avatar || saving || reading} onClick={() => { setAvatar('') setSaved(false) setDirty(true) }} >

useMutation({ mutationFn: () => api.saveSettings({ provider, model, base_url: address, api_key: key, ...(connection ? { ...(connection.id ? { profile_id: connection.id } : {}), label, make_default: false } : {}), }), onSuccess: async (updated) => { setKey('') cache.setQueryData(['model-settings'], updated) await cache.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['conversation'] }) }, }

onChange={(value) => { const selected = value as ModelSettings['provider'] const profile = settings.profiles?.[selected] setProvider(selected) setModel(profile?.model ?? catalog[selected].models[0]) setAddress(profile?.base_url ?? catalog[selected].base_url) setKey('') save.reset() }}

useMutation({ mutationFn: (connection: ModelConnection) => api.saveSettings({ provider: connection.provider, model: connection.model, base_url: connection.base_url, profile_id: connection.id, label: connection.label, api_key: '', }), onSuccess: (updated) => cache.setQueryData(['model-settings'], updated), }

useMutation({ mutationFn: (item: ModelConnection) => api.saveSettings({ provider: item.provider, model: item.model, base_url: item.base_url, profile_id: item.id, label: item.label, api_key: '', make_default: false, enabled: item.enabled === false, }), onSuccess: (updated) => cache.setQueryData(['model-settings'], updated), }
<button type="button" className="connection-edit" aria-label={`编辑 ${item.label}`} aria-expanded={editing === item.id} onClick={() => setEditing(item.id)} >

<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked={item.enabled !== false} aria-label={`启用 ${item.label}`} className="secondary-button" title={isDefault(item) ? '请先更换默认模型，再停用' : '停用后隐藏，保留密钥和配置'} disabled={isDefault(item) || toggle.isPending} onClick={() => toggle.mutate(item)} >

<button type="button" className="secondary-button" disabled={!item.api_key_set || item.enabled === false || makeDefault.isPending} onClick={() => makeDefault.mutate(item)} aria-label={`设为默认 ${item.label}`} >
<button className="secondary-button" onClick={() => { void settings.refetch() void catalog.refetch() }} >

<button className="secondary-button copy-data-path" onClick={async () => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(data.data!.data_dir) setNotice('数据位置已复制') } catch { setNotice('无法自动复制，请选中上方路径手动复制。') } }} >
onClick={async () => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(data.data!.data_dir) setNotice('数据位置已复制') } catch { setNotice('无法自动复制，请选中上方路径手动复制。') } }}

<button key={id} type="button" role="tab" id={`settings-tab-${id}`} aria-selected={position === index} aria-controls={`settings-panel-${id}`} tabIndex={position === index ? 0 : -1} onClick={() => select(position)} onKeyDown={(event) => { const target = event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? (index + 1) % sections.length : event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? (index + sections.length - 1) % sections.length : event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : event.key === 'End' ? sections.length - 1 : -1 if (target >= 0) { event.preventDefault() select(target) document.getElementById(`settings-tab-${sections[target].id}`)?.focus() } }} >

onKeyDown={(event) => { const target = event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? (index + 1) % sections.length : event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? (index + sections.length - 1) % sections.length : event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : event.key === 'End' ? sections.length - 1 : -1 if (target >= 0) { event.preventDefault() select(target) document.getElementById(`settings-tab-${sections[target].id}`)?.focus() } }}
<Link className="home-profile" to="/settings?section=profile" state={{ backgroundLocation: location }} aria-label={`${preferences.displayName || '你'}的个人设置`} >
onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault() if (draft.trim() && !ask.isPending) ask.mutate({ draft: draft.trim() }) }}
<button type="button" className="home-attach" aria-label="导入文件或链接" title="导入文件或链接" onClick={() => setCapture(true)} >
<button type="button" className="home-capture" aria-label="快速收录" title="快速收录到收件箱" onClick={() => setCapture(true)} >
<button className="home-send" aria-label="在助手中继续" title="开始对话" disabled={ask.isPending || !draft.trim()} >
onSaved={() => { setCapture(false) void cache.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['content'] }) void cache.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['inbox'] }) }}
